data.message: I commit to 18 tons as an individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Each switch costs8 remaining and16 next stock in the low outcome. This isn't guaranteed long-run optimal; intentions aren't binding. Other allocations need recalculation.
